original: ……ね？\nこれってやっぱり、二人の事だよね
traducao: ...Right?\nThis is about the two of you, isn't it?

original: 確かに、間違いない
traducao: Yeah, there's no doubt about it.

original: それにしても、\nこんな大事になるなんて……。\nまいったな
traducao: Even so, for it to become\nsuch a big deal...\nI can't believe this.

original: アスベル……困ってるの？\nどうして？
traducao: Asbel... Are you troubled?\nWhy?

original: ソフィ、どうやら俺達\n捜索願が出されてるみたいなんだ
traducao: Sophie, it seems a search request\nhas been put out for us.

original: 捜索……願？
traducao: A search... request?

original: 居所のわからない人を、\n「探して下さい」って\n周りの色んな人にお願いする事だよ
traducao: It's when you ask people around you\nto search for someone whose\nwhereabouts are unknown.

original: 居所……わからない？\nわたし達は、ここにいるよ
traducao: Whereabouts... unknown?\nWe're right here.

original: ……そうなんだよ
traducao: ...Yeah, I know.

original: 俺達がここにいる事を、\nあいつに伝えていなかったんだ
traducao: We never told her\nthat we were here.

original: 仕方がないな……
traducao: It can't be helped...

original: ふふ。\nじゃあ、この依頼は\n二人にお願いした方が良さそうね
traducao: Hehe.\nThen it seems best to leave\nthis request to the two of you.

original: 念の為、他にも誰か\n協力してくれる人を募ってみましょうか
traducao: Just in case, why don't we see\nif someone else can help out too?

original: クエスト「幼馴染み捜索願」が\nエントリーされました。\nクエストカウンタから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: Quest 'Search for a Childhood Friend'\nhas been registered.\nYou can accept it at the Quest Counter.

original: やっぱり、○○が\n手伝ってくれるのね。ありがとう
traducao: I knew you would help out,\n○○. Thank you.

original: すまない……。\n少しの間だけど、よろしく頼む
traducao: Sorry about this...\nWe'll be counting on you for a bit.

original: ○○、よろしく
traducao: ○○, nice to work with you.

original: あいつ、こんな所まで\n俺達を探しに来てるなんて……
traducao: To think she came all the way\nout here looking for us...

original: ここ……。\nアスベルと一緒に、前にも来たね
traducao: This place...\nI came here before with Asbel.

original: ああ。\nソフィと最初の任務で来た場所だ
traducao: Yeah.\nWhere Sophie and I had our first mission.

original: 手がかりがないから、\nとにかくしらみつぶしに\nあちこちを探してるって事だな
traducao: With no clues to go on,\nshe must be combing through\nevery place she can think of.

original: 早く見つけて、誤解を解かないと
traducao: We must find her and clear this up soon.

original: うん。\nきっとすごく、心配してるよ
traducao: Yeah.\nShe must be so worried about us.

original: あ……綺麗な石
traducao: Ah... What a pretty stone.

original: あ、こらソフィ！
traducao: Ah, hey, Sophie!

original: だめじゃないか……。\nああ、やっぱり服に泥が付いてる
traducao: You shouldn't run off like that...\nAh, look, you got mud on your clothes.

original: あいつに見つかったら、\nまた怒られるな
traducao: If she sees you like this,\nshe's going to scold us again.

original: ごめんなさい……。\nこの石、シェリアにあげたら\nきっと喜ぶと思ったの
traducao: I'm sorry...\nI thought Cheria would be happy\nif I gave her this stone.

original: アスベル……怒ってる？
traducao: Asbel... Are you mad at me?

original: いや、怒ってないよ。\nだけど、後でちゃんと洗わないとな
traducao: No, I'm not mad.\nWe'll need to wash that properly later.

original: ああ、すまない
traducao: Ah, sorry about that.

original: 俺の幼馴染み……シェリアっていうんだが\n身だしなみに厳しくてさ
traducao: My childhood friend Cheria is\npretty strict about keeping clean.

original: 特に服を汚すと怒られるんだ。\n女の子は綺麗にしないとダメだって
traducao: She gets mad if our clothes get dirty.\nShe says girls must keep tidy.

original: 気付いたら、こんなやりとりが\n当たり前になってしまって
traducao: Before I knew it, conversations like this\njust became normal for us.

original: でも……、わたし\nシェリアの事好きだよ
traducao: Even so...\nI really love Cheria.

original: アスベルもそうだよね
traducao: You do too, right, Asbel?

original: えっ？\nああ、まあ、そうだな
traducao: Huh?\nYeah, well, I guess so.

original: ……早く、会いたいな。\nシェリア
traducao: ...I want to see her soon.\nCheria, I mean.

original: あっ、シェリア！
traducao: Ah, Cheria!

original: えっ……ソフィ！？\nそれに、アスベルも？
traducao: Huh... Sophie?!\nAnd Asbel, too?
H-Hey...

original: やあ
traducao: Hey there.

original: 「やあ」じゃないわよ！
traducao: Don't you "hey there" me!

original: もう……。\n私が、どれだけ心配したと思ってるの？\nしんっじられない！
traducao: Honestly...\nDo you know how worried I was?\nI can't believe you two!

original: ごめん
traducao: I'm sorry.

original: 今はソフィと一緒に、アドリビトムに\n間借りさせてもらっているんだ
traducao: Right now Sophie and I are staying\nwith Ad Libitum.

original: あのね、すっごく大きな船なの。\nシェリアも見たらびっくりするよ
traducao: You know, it's a huge ship.\nCheria, you'll be amazed to see it!

original: アドリビトム……？\nじゃあ二人がここにいるのって
traducao: Ad Libitum...?\nThen the reason you two are here is...

original: 捜索願……びっくりしたよ。\nまさかそこまで心配かけてるなんて\n思わなくてさ
traducao: That search request really surprised me.\nI had no idea we had caused you\nso much worry.

original: アスベル、困ってた
traducao: Asbel was troubled by it.

original: いや、困ってたというか……
traducao: Well, it wasn't that, exactly...

original: そういう事だったのね
traducao: So that's what happened.

original: はぁ……もう。\n大騒ぎしちゃって、恥ずかしい……
traducao: Sigh... Good grief.\nMaking such a fuss is so embarrassing...

original: シェリア。\n元気出して
traducao: Cheria.\nCheer up.

original: ……ありがとう、ソフィ。\n私は大丈夫よ
traducao: ...Thank you, Sophie.\nI'm all right.

original: これからはソフィとも一緒だから、\nこうやって心配する事は\nなくなると思うし
traducao: From now on I'll be with Sophie,\nso I don't think I'll have to worry\nlike this anymore.

original: え？　それってどういう意味だ？
traducao: Huh? What do you mean by that?

original: 決まってるじゃない。\n私も今日から、そのギルドで\nお世話になるわ
traducao: Isn't it obvious?\nStarting today, I'll be staying\nwith that guild too.

original: あそこなら、私の治癒術も\n色んな人の役に立てられそうだもの。\n何だか、恋の話も聞けそうだしっ
traducao: There, my healing artes can be useful\nto many people. And maybe I'll even\nget to hear some love stories!

original: そっちが本当の目的……じゃないよな？
traducao: That's not your real motive... is it?

original: べ、別に\nそんなんじゃないわよ
traducao: N-No,\nit's not like that at all!

original: さあ、ソフィ？\n一緒にバンエルティア号へ行きましょう
traducao: Come on, Sophie.\nLet's head to the Van Eltia together!

original: ……うん。\nみんな、一緒で嬉しいね。\n○○
traducao: ...Yeah.\nI'm happy we're all together,\n○○.

original: ふぅ……。\nこれで一件落着、だな
traducao: Phew...\nThat settles that, then.

original: 一件落着じゃありません
traducao: It is not settled at all!

original: ソフィ？\n服に付いてるその泥、どうしたの？
traducao: Sophie?\nWhat's all that mud on your clothes?

original: これは……
traducao: This is...

original: ごめん。\nちょっと俺が目を離した時に\n水たまりに……
traducao: I'm sorry.\nWhen I looked away for a second,\nshe fell into a puddle...

original: でも、このくらいの汚れなら\nお湯で洗えば落ちるだろ？
traducao: But with dirt like this,\nhot water should wash it right out.

original: はぁ……。\nやっぱり、そんな事だろうと思ったわ
traducao: Sigh...\nI figured it was something like that.

original: いいわ、私がまとめて洗っておくから。\nアスベルも何か洗う物があったら\n出しておいて
traducao: Fine, I'll wash them all together.\nAsbel, if you have anything to wash,\nbring it out now.

original: 俺は、いいよ
traducao: I'm good, thanks.

original: そう？\nアスベルもそこの裾、泥がはねてるけど
traducao: Really?\nAsbel, mud splashed on your hem too.
Ah...

original: 白い服だから\nそういうの、目立つのよね
traducao: Your clothes are white,\nso that really stands out, you know.

original: シェリア……鋭い
traducao: Cheria is so sharp...

original: うう……、返す言葉がない
traducao: Ugh... I have no excuse for that.

original: そういうわけで
traducao: At any rate...

original: ええと、○○……\nだったわよね？
traducao: Um, it was ○○...\nright?

original: しばらくの間、お世話になります。\nこれから、よろしくね
traducao: I'll be in your care for a while.\nI look forward to working with you.

original: シェリアがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Cheria joined Ad Libitum.
